current.text: He is not in the projected Washington starting five of Trae Young, Kyshawn George, AJ Dybantsa, Anthony Davis and Alex Sarr.
Washington has a crowded group of wings and guards. The fifth starter spot is open, with many wings competing for it.
Experts expect a 10 or 11 man rotation, with 12 or 13 players who could justify minutes. That spreads minutes thin.
Washington added Anthony Davis, Trae Young and AJ Dybantsa.
Experts say these additions cut into the roles of the young players and leave little usage for others.
Washington says the rebuild is over and is trying to compete.
Because the team is trying to compete, experts do not expect the late-season resting and minutes cuts of past years.
He scored 25 points on 20 shots in his one Summer League game.

durable.text: An expert calls him probably the best shooter on the Wizards.
An expert worries that he does nothing besides score.

note: Both sites value him at 0 USD and rank him 226 (Yahoo) and 235 (ESPN), far outside the 144 players we draft, so do not draft him. He offers about 2.0 threes per game and a good FT% on low volume, but rates below average in FG%, REB, STL and BLK, and he is not projected to start on a crowded Washington wing group. Early in the season, check whether he wins the open fifth starter spot or a steady 24 plus minutes. Only then is he worth a waiver look as a three-point streamer.
